# Home Management — Full Technical & Methodology Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Comprehensive documentation of Home Management (https://home-management.dev), a free, local-first household water, heating, and electricity consumption tracker and forecasting web application.

## 1. Product Summary & Licensing

- **Name**: Home Management
- **Canonical URL**: https://home-management.dev/
- **Web App Entry**: https://home-management.dev/dashboard
- **Public Benchmarks**: https://home-management.dev/dashboard/benchmarks

---

## 2. Privacy & Storage Architecture

1. **Local-First Default (`HybridStorageService`)**:
   - All meter readings, household member profiles, room configurations, and address preferences are stored locally in the browser (`localStorage`) by default.
   - No account, email address, or sign-up is required to use the full feature set.
2. **Optional Cloud Sync**:
   - Users may optionally sign in with Google Authentication to synchronize their encrypted household records across devices via Google Cloud Firestore.
   - Users can sign out or delete their cloud data at any time while retaining local exports.
3. **Zero Third-Party Tracking**:
   - Home Management serves zero advertisements, uses no third-party marketing pixels, and enforces a strict Content Security Policy (CSP).

---

## 3. Utility Tracking Methodology

### 3.1 Water Consumption Tracker (`/dashboard/water`)
- **Sub-Metering Layout**: Supports separate cumulative meter readings (in `m³`) for:
  - Kitchen Warm Water & Kitchen Cold Water
  - Bathroom Warm Water & Bathroom Cold Water
  - Optional **Cold-Water-Only Mode** for households with a single main cold water meter or instantaneous water heaters.
- **Delta & Daily Rate Calculation**:
  - Given two consecutive readings $(t_1, v_1)$ and $(t_2, v_2)$, incremental volume is $\Delta V = (v_2 - v_1) \times 1000$ liters over $\Delta d = \max(1, \text{days}(t_2 - t_1))$ days.
  - Per-person daily consumption is computed as $\frac{\Delta V}{\Delta d \times N_{\text{members}}}$ L/person/day.
- **Meter Replacement Handling**:
  - When a physical water meter is replaced or resets to zero, users flag the reading as a meter change (or confirm the detected drop). The delta engine calculates consumption across the swap boundary without producing negative spikes or corrupting historical totals.

### 3.2 Heating Consumption Tracker (`/dashboard/heating`)
- **Room-Level Sub-Metering**:
  - Users configure custom rooms (e.g., Living Room, Bedroom, Kitchen, Office, Bathroom) and record heat cost allocator units or kWh readings per room.
- **Seasonal Weighting & Anomaly Detection**:
  - Tracks cumulative and incremental room-level heating consumption across heating seasons (autumn/winter vs. spring/summer) and flags abnormal room spikes or newly added rooms.

### 3.3 Electricity Consumption Tracker (`/dashboard/electricity`)
- **Cumulative kWh Tracking**:
  - Records main meter readings in `kWh`, automatically deriving daily (`kWh/day`), monthly, and annual consumption trends.
  - Detects meter replacements when a reading is lower than the prior reading and prompts the user to confirm the meter reset.

---

## 4. Statistical Forecasting & Bias Correction

- **Minimum Data Threshold**: Requires at least 4 chronological meter readings to unlock predictions.
- **Forecast Horizons**: 30 Days, 90 Days, Half Year (180 Days), 1 Year (365 Days), and 10 Years.
- **Algorithm**:
  - Combines weighted recent daily consumption rates with seasonal adjustment multipliers and linear/polynomial trend regression.
  - **Historical Bias Auto-Correction**: Backtests prior predictions against actual recorded consumption and applies an automatic percentage bias correction factor when systematic over- or under-estimation is detected.
  - Outputs expected consumption, min/max confidence bounds, and a confidence rating (`High`, `Medium`, `Low`) based on sample count and variance.

---

## 5. On-Device Camera Meter Reader (OCR)

- **Client-Side Pipeline**:
  1. Captures a photo from the device camera (`MediaDevices.getUserMedia`) or file upload.
  2. Allows interactive bounding-box cropping around the meter digit drum.
  3. Preprocesses the cropped image on an HTML5 `<canvas>` (grayscale conversion, contrast stretching, and adaptive thresholding) to improve digit legibility.
  4. Runs optical character recognition locally in a Web Worker using **Tesseract.js**.
- **Privacy Guarantee**: Meter photos are processed 100% in browser memory and are never uploaded to any external server.

---

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

- **Does Home Management require an account or subscription?**
  No. Home Management is 100% free for personal and household use and runs immediately in your browser without registration. Optional Google sign-in is only needed if you want to sync data across devices.
- **Where is my utility data stored?**
  By default, all data is stored locally in your browser (`localStorage`). Nothing leaves your device unless you explicitly enable Firebase cloud sync or export a backup file.
- **How does the AI camera meter reader work?**
  You take or upload a photo of your meter, crop the digits, and an in-browser Tesseract.js OCR worker extracts the reading directly on your device. Images are never sent to a server.
- **Can I import my existing Excel spreadsheets?**
  Yes. You can map custom columns from existing `.xlsx` spreadsheets, paste raw text tables using Smart Import, and export your records to Excel (`.xlsx`), JSON, or formatted PDF reports at any time.
